decision.rationale: Publish the accumulated post-0.5.1 package changes so public-registry consumers can resolve the same geometry, core, renderer, language-service, Markdown, and CLI contracts exercised by the current workspace.
decision.notes: This is a genuine candidate with source changes in every package listed as planned. No package is to be published until the operator completes the candidate preflight and reviews the tarballs.

sourceChanges.summary: Accumulated geometry normalization, composition, placement, query, numeric, and boundary coverage after the 0.5.0 publication.
Accumulated core runtime diagnostics, semantic, geometry-consumer, and capability closure changes after the published 0.5.2 source.
Accumulated semantic SVG parity, safety, accessibility metadata, and renderer capability changes after 0.5.0.
Accumulated editor protocol, diagnostics, provenance, and language-service capability closure changes after 0.5.1.
Hardened highlighting fallback, escaping, and Markdown boundary behavior after 0.5.0.
Hardened preview rendering, assets, sanitization, and accessibility boundaries after 0.5.0.
Closed CLI authoring and environment-handling gaps after 0.5.0.

candidateSource.note: Run the candidate audit, build, compatibility, local integration, and tarball checks before publish.

openGates: Publish only the seven changed npm packages in matrix release order after the operator reviews preflight output.
Do not publish playground or relgeo.github.io; they are consumers, not npm package targets.
After publishing, run registry verification and public integration, then update this record to completed or partial.
